title: Best Friends in Forever
caption: Keep up with your friends in WoW: Forever, even when you play at different times.

title: While you were away
caption: Log in to every ding, death and new character your friends had since you last played.

title: Your whole crew
caption: Every friend's characters, levels and whereabouts, and when each was last seen.

title: Cheer every ding
caption: One click sends a cheer for a ding, respects for a death, or a welcome for someone new.

title: Level up together
caption: Goals the whole crew works towards, like everyone reaching level 80. Nobody is ranked.

title: Pass on spare gear
caption: Offer an item to your friends. Whoever claims it first gets it by in‑game mail.

title: When everyone plays
caption: A heatmap of the hours each friend usually plays, in your own time zone.

title: Start a crew
caption: No server, no account, and no shared guild needed.
steps: Everyone in the group installs BFF.
One friend types `/bff start` and shares the code.
The others type `/bff join` with the code.
